title: Main Deck Cargo Floor Panels Frames 40 to 54 — Installation
abstract: Installation of the main deck cargo floor panels between frames 40 and 54, with the reduced edge fastener pitch used on provisioned aircraft and the floor loading check that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task installs the cargo floor panels between frames 40 and 54 and proves the floor by a distributed loading check before the cabin is rebuilt over it.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the bays clean and with every fastener hole checked for thread damage. The edge fastener pitch is not the same on all aircraft: provisioned aircraft use a reduced pitch across the reinforced edges and the fastener count per panel is higher. Read the effectivity note before the panels go down. Shim the panel at any corner that stands proud, using the shim sequence in the torque table, and do not exceed the shim stack given there. Three persons are needed to lift and place each panel.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the bay is clean and that no tool or fastener is left below. 2. Check every fastener hole in the panel seat for thread damage and repair any damaged thread before the panel goes down. 3. Fit the panel support frame and lift the first panel into its marked bay and orientation. 4. Put four screws in at the corners hand tight. CAUTION: DO NOT DRIVE ANY SCREW UNTIL ALL FOUR CORNERS ARE ENGAGED. THE PANEL WILL DISTORT. 5. Install the remaining countersunk screws AGS895094-3D at the pitch given for the aircraft standard, working from the centre outwards. 6. Torque all screws to the value in the torque table. 7. Repeat for the second panel of the bay and for each remaining bay. 8. Where the freighter hard points are fitted, check that each upper lug sub-assembly HA342629-96 is capped and that the cap is flush with the panel. 9. Check the seat track lock actuator position 8300VU for free movement over the reinstalled panels. 10. Remove the temporary walkway. 11. Do the distributed floor loading check to the load and duration given in the accomplishment instructions and check for permanent set. WARNING: KEEP ALL PERSONNEL CLEAR OF THE BAY DURING THE LOADING CHECK. 12. Install the cabin floor covering and the seats.
sections.close_out: Do a visual check of the panel joints for step and gap. Make sure that all bay markings are removed. Record the installation, the torque values and the result of the loading check, and update the aircraft mass and balance record if the freighter provisions were added during this visit.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the reduced edge pitch applies to aircraft post MOD-132210 only

safety_precautions: Keep all personnel clear of the bay during the loading check.
Fit the panel support frame before any panel is lifted.
Account for every tool before a bay is closed.

title: Main Deck Cargo Floor Panels Frames 40 to 54 — Installation

issue.reason: The panel underside to distribution manifold clearance is stated as a dimension and a measurement step is added at the three affected frame stations.

abstract: Installation of the main deck cargo floor panels between frames 40 and 54, with the reduced edge fastener pitch used on provisioned aircraft, the stated clearance to the suppression distribution manifold and the floor loading check that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task installs the cargo floor panels between frames 40 and 54 and proves the floor by a distributed loading check before the cabin is rebuilt over it.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the bays clean and with every fastener hole checked for thread damage. The edge fastener pitch is not the same on all aircraft: provisioned aircraft use a reduced pitch across the reinforced edges and the fastener count per panel is higher. Read the effectivity note before the panels go down. The shim sequence in the torque table sets the height of the panel underside, and on aircraft carrying the extended discharge suppression standard that height is what holds the clearance to the distribution manifold beneath frames 44, 48 and 52. The clearance is 18 mm minimum, measured cold from the manifold outer surface to the reinforced panel edge, and it is now stated here rather than left to the shim stack: a panel shimmed high on one corner takes it out without anything looking wrong from above. Three persons are needed to lift and place each panel.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the bay is clean and that no tool or fastener is left below. 2. Check every fastener hole in the panel seat for thread damage and repair any damaged thread before the panel goes down. 3. Fit the panel support frame and lift the first panel into its marked bay and orientation. 4. Put four screws in at the corners hand tight. CAUTION: DO NOT DRIVE ANY SCREW UNTIL ALL FOUR CORNERS ARE ENGAGED. THE PANEL WILL DISTORT. 5. Install the remaining countersunk screws AGS895094-3D at the pitch given for the aircraft standard, working from the centre outwards. 6. Torque all screws to the value in the torque table. 7. Repeat for the second panel of the bay and for each remaining bay. 8. On aircraft at the extended discharge suppression standard, measure the clearance from the manifold outer surface to the panel underside at frames 44, 48 and 52 with the depth gauge through the inspection hole, and record all three readings. The minimum is 18 mm. CAUTION: A READING BELOW 18 MM IS CORRECTED BY RE-SHIMMING THE PANEL, NEVER BY MOVING THE MANIFOLD. THE MANIFOLD ROUTING IS FIXED BY THE INSTALLATION DRAWING. 9. Where the freighter hard points are fitted, check that each upper lug sub-assembly HA342629-96 is capped and that the cap is flush with the panel. 10. Check the seat track lock actuator position 8300VU for free movement over the reinstalled panels. 11. Remove the temporary walkway. 12. Do the distributed floor loading check to the load and duration given in the accomplishment instructions and check for permanent set. WARNING: KEEP ALL PERSONNEL CLEAR OF THE BAY DURING THE LOADING CHECK. 13. Repeat the clearance measurement at frame 48 after the loading check and confirm it has not changed. 14. Install the cabin floor covering and the seats.
sections.close_out: Do a visual check of the panel joints for step and gap. Make sure that all bay markings are removed. Record the installation, the torque values, the three manifold clearance readings where they apply and the result of the loading check, and update the aircraft mass and balance record if the freighter provisions were added during this visit.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the reduced edge pitch applies to aircraft post MOD-132210 only, and steps 8 and 13 to aircraft post MOD-134860 only

safety_precautions: Keep all personnel clear of the bay during the loading check.
Fit the panel support frame before any panel is lifted.
Account for every tool before a bay is closed.
